items.title: Yusef Lateef — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: like the late James Baldwin said, “Beware of how people define you, define that which you do, because they may misrepresent you.”

ctx.x: Sure. Or both, let’s talk about both: the public and the critics.

Well, there’s a disparity on one hand uh...frequently, during that, the earlier period. Uh one could read a review, and the critic might not even recognize the form of the music. Um...and when that happens...one can uh come to a conclusion that perhaps they really didn’t know what they were listening to, if you misidentify a form. Um...of course, perhaps, that’s excusable, because none of us are perfect, but on the other hand this discredits the person if, if he’s misidentified, what he’s doing is, is not um…
That may be true, yeah. That’s, that’s not an unfair assessment in many ways, I think. When did you move to New York?
